text:
Raj Patel: Heads up — our GPU-hours forecasting pipeline missed APAC usage for the last 12h. Ingestion logs show 0 events for ap-northeast-1 between 03:00–15:00 UTC. Anyone seeing upstream issues?

infra-bot: ALERT: ingest-pipeline - missing-partitions - region=ap-northeast-1 - window=2026-03-10T03:00:00Z..2026-03-10T15:00:00Z

Maya Chen: Dashboard shows an ingest-latency spike then a total gap. Query I ran: `SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.usage_logs WHERE region='ap-northeast-1' AND ts >= '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY hour;` returns zeros for that window.

Connor Liu: We had a small network flap in ap-northeast-1. Host pool G-13 egress was rate-limited due to a noisy NIC, and there was a BGP withdraw around 03:05 UTC that affected the mirror lane.

Alice Nguyen: Confirmed — the kafka-mirror connector crashed and failed to auto-restart. Logs show: `ERROR ConsumerGroupCoordinator - IllegalStateException: group has no coordinator`. No pod restart because `restartPolicy: OnFailure` didn't trigger for this exception.

Connor Liu: I'm going to restart the connector and check mirror lags. Command I'll run:
```
kubectl -n telemetry rollout restart deployment/kafka-mirror-apac --context=cluster-apac
```

Maya Chen: If we backfill raw usage logs we need the forecasting pipeline to do a windowed re-agg; the model feature job expects contiguous hourly aggregates. Proposed backfill job: `python backfill.py --region ap-northeast-1 --start 2026-03-10T03:00:00Z --end 2026-03-10T15:00:00Z --mode incremental`

Bob Rivera: Cost question — will the backfill spin up GPUs for recompute? How many GPU-hours are we talking about?

Alice Nguyen: Short answer: yes for feature recompute if we run model-based feature extraction. Rough estimate: ~120 GPU-hours if we do full recompute with 4x A100s parallelism. We can do a two-pass strategy: CPU rollup to produce non-ML features, then GPU run for ML-only features, dropping GPU hours to ~30-40.

Raj Patel: We need clear metric defs so downstream teams understand impact. Proposed defs: `gpu_hours_consumed` = sum(instance_uptime_hours * gpu_count * avg_utilization_pct / 100); `ingest_coverage` = events_received / expected_events_by_hour. Add `replication_lag_minutes` = max(consumer_lag) / 60.

Maya Chen: I'll add SQL definitions into the metrics repo. Example snippet for ingest_coverage:
```
-- ingest_coverage per hour
SELECT
  hour_ts,
  region,
  count(received_event_id) as events_received,
  expected_count as expected_events,
  count(received_event_id)::float / expected_count as ingest_coverage
FROM telemetry.usage_logs
JOIN telemetry.expected_hourly_counts USING (hour_ts, region)
WHERE region = 'ap-northeast-1' AND hour_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T15:00:00Z'
GROUP BY hour_ts, region, expected_count;
```

Connor Liu: Connector restart in progress. infra-bot: please emit progress updates.

infra-bot: ACTION: rollout restart triggered for deployment/kafka-mirror-apac (hash=sha256:7f3b...). Current pods terminating -> creating.

infra-bot: STATUS: connector ready. replicator lag=0, backlog queued= ~12h of messages (estimated 1.4M events). Throttling policy: replica.rate_limit=2000 msgs/s.

Maya Chen: I'll wait for lag to clear then kick off the incremental backfill with `--mode incremental`. ETA for backfill run: ~2h after lag=0. Will post progress to this thread.

Raj Patel: Assigning owners — Maya for the backfill/data pipeline, Connor for networking/connector stability. @sre-oncall please monitor ap-northeast-1 egress for 24h and escalate if replication lag >30m.

sre-oncall: Ack. I'll add an alert: `replication_lag_minutes > 30 for region ap-northeast-1` and hold PagerDuty until cleared. Will watch network metrics and BGP session counts too.

Bob Rivera: :thumbsup: Please tag the backfill run with `cost_center=forecasting` so finance can track the GPU hours. Also request an estimate of final GPU-hours after results.

Maya Chen: Will do. I'll update the forecast dashboard once recompute finishes and push a patch to the metrics docs with the new definitions and the backfill run id.

Raj Patel: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem action items: (1) make kafka-mirror deployment `Always` restart on these error classes; (2) add expected_events sanity check to ingest pipeline to alert earlier; (3) add a cheap CPU-based checksum pass to avoid unnecessary GPU recompute when no deltas.

Connor Liu: Noted. I'll file infra PR for the restartPolicy change and add a network-policy rule to reduce noisy NIC impact.

Alice Nguyen: I'll draft the backfill runbook with CPU-first path and GPU-fallback, include time/cost estimates.

Maya Chen: Posting follow-up: backfill started at 1760870205; first hourly aggregates recomputed, currently 6/12 hours complete.

infra-bot: EVENT: backfill job completed successfully. backfill_id=bf-20260310-001, gpu_hours_used=36, total_rows_processed=1,382,454.

Raj Patel: Great — final GPU-hours 36 (matches Alice's CPU-first plan). Closing the loop. Please add the incident notes to the capacity forecast doc and bump expected_event_count reliability weighting for APAC by +10% for Q3.

Bob Rivera: Adding note for finance. Thanks.
